articles.summary: Recognition marks second consecutive year Amneal has been named a BioSpace Best Place to Work BRIDGEWATER, N.J., Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: AMRX) (“Amneal” or the “Company”) today announced that it has been named a BioSpace 2027 Best Place to Work, earning the No.1 ranking among large employers in the life sciences industry. The recognition marks the second consecutive year Amneal has been named to BioSpace’s Best Places to Work list, rising from the No.4 ranking among large employers last year. “We are incredibly proud to be recognized as the No.1 Best Place to Work among large employers by BioSpace,” said Nikita Shah, Executive Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer of Amneal. “This recognition belongs to our people and reflects the strong culture they help shape every day.
